summary.purpose: Extracts Commercial Package Policy (CPP) incurred losses with line of business remapping, transaction details, and financial amounts for incurred loss analysis in ClaimCenter.
summary.high_level_narrative: The script declares date parameters (unused in visible query) and executes a multi-layered query. The innermost subquery joins core ClaimCenter views (transactionlineitem, transaction, transactionset, claim, policy, check, reserveline, exposure, coverage, contact, user, riskunit, classcode) and numerous type-code lookup views. It derives key attributes: PolSource (Legacy/Guidewire), row numbers for reserve lines, claim representatives based on state and subrogation, company codes, formatted dates, TFGASL/GWASL codes based on coverage type and loss cause, accounting date (CreateTime vs ApprovalDate), TFGTran codes via complex case logic covering Reserve, Payment, and Recovery transactions with cost type and DoesNotErodeReserves flags, and signed transaction amounts. The middle query selects these derived columns. The outer query remaps LOBCode (Business Owners Line -> BP7Line, Workers Comp% -> Workers Comp Line), groups by PolSource, remapped LOBCode, and PolicyNumber, and sums TransAmount as IncurredAmount.
summary.business_domain: ClaimCenter / Commercial Package Policy (CPP) Claims / Incurred Loss Analysis
outputs: Result set: PolSource, LOBCode (remapped), IncurredAmount (SUM TransAmount), PolicyNumber

ClaimRep1 assignment: InRepID_ext for state '13' else OhRepID_ext
ClaimRep2 assignment from SubroRepresentative_Ext via user join
Company code mapping: LRM, WRM, SON for specific underwriting companies else UNK
Date formatting to YYYYMMDD char(8) for PolOrgEffDate, PolEffDate, PolExpDate, AcctDate
TFGASL/GWASL mapping based on coverage typecode and loss cause typecode
AcctDate logic: tl.CreateTime if >= tset.ApprovalDate else tset.ApprovalDate
TFGTran code derivation: 431/432 for reserves, 321/331/322/332 for payments, 321/322/341/342/351/353 for recoveries based on cost type and recovery category
TransAmount sign logic: Payment with DoesNotErodeReserves=0 -> negative; Recovery -> negative; else positive
Amount formatting to fixed-width signed numeric strings (12 chars)
LOBCode remapping: 'Business Owners Line' -> 'BP7Line', 'Workers%' -> 'Workers Comp Line'

outputs: LOBCode (remapped: BP7Line, Workers Comp Line, or original)

Inner subquery joins 15+ views to gather claim, policy, transaction, coverage, exposure, user, and type code data.
Compute ROW_NUMBER() over partition by ClaimNumber, exposure id, transaction type, cost type for reserve transactions to sequence rows.
Derive PolSource: 'Legacy' if PolicyPrefix_Ext is NULL else 'Guidewire'.
Map LOBCode: 'Business Owners Line' -> 'BP7Line', 'Workers%' -> 'Workers Comp Line', else original LOB name.
Derive ClaimRep1 based on ProducerCode prefix '13' using u1.InRepID_ext else u1.OhRepID_ext.
Derive ClaimRep2 from SubroRepresentative_Ext via u2.SubroRepId_Ext.

Determine AcctDate_sql/AcctDate as later of tl.CreateTime and tset.ApprovalDate (default 01/01/2000).

transformations.description: Map PolicyPrefix_Ext to PolSource: 'Legacy' if NULL else 'Guidewire'
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN po.PolicyPrefix_Ext IS NULL THEN 'Legacy' ELSE 'Guidewire' END

transformations.description: Remap LOBCode: 'Business Owners Line' -> 'BP7Line', 'Workers%' -> 'Workers Comp Line', else original
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN LOBCode = 'Business Owners Line' THEN 'BP7Line' WHEN LOBCode LIKE 'Workers%' THEN 'Workers Comp Line' ELSE LOBCode END

transformations.description: ROW_NUMBER for reserve transactions partitioned by ClaimNumber, exposure id, transaction type, cost type ordered by CreateTime
transformations.expression: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cl.ClaimNumber, ex.id, tt.TYPECODE, cst.NAME ORDER BY tl.CreateTime)

transformations.description: Derive ClaimRep1: if ProducerCode starts with '13' use u1.InRepID_ext else u1.OhRepID_ext, left 5 chars
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN LEFT(cl.ProducerCode,2)='13' THEN LEFT(ISNULL(u1.InRepID_ext,'00000'),5) ELSE LEFT(ISNULL(u1.OhRepID_ext,'00000'),5) END

transformations.description: Derive ClaimRep2 from subro representative: if SubroRepresentative_Ext not null then u2.SubroRepId_Ext left 5 else '00000'
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN cl.SubroRepresentative_Ext IS NULL THEN '00000' ELSE ISNULL(LEFT(u2.SubroRepId_Ext,5),'00000') END

transformations.description: Map underwriting company name to 3-char code: LRM, WRM, SON, else UNK
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN uw.name='Lightning Rod Mutual Insurance Company' THEN 'LRM' WHEN uw.name='Western Reserve Mutual Casualty Company' THEN 'WRM' WHEN uw.name='Sonnenberg Mutual Insurance Company' THEN 'SON' ELSE 'UNK' END

transformations.description: Format dates as CHAR(8) YYYYMMDD using CONVERT(101) and REPLACE
transformations.expression: CAST(REPLACE(CONVERT(char(10), datecol, 101), '/', '') AS CHAR(8))

transformations.description: AcctDate = later of tl.CreateTime and tset.ApprovalDate (default 01/01/2000)
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN tl.CreateTime >= ISNULL(tset.ApprovalDate,'01/01/2000') THEN CAST(tl.CreateTime AS date) ELSE CAST(tset.approvaldate AS date) END

transformations.description: TFGASL coverage mapping: 270 for CPEquipBrkCov, 010 for CPINCCCov or CicsClaimCov_Ext in (615,616,617,618), else 021
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPEquipBrkCov') THEN '270' WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPINCCCov') THEN '010' WHEN cv.CicsClaimCov_Ext IN ('615','616','617','618') THEN '010' ELSE '021' END

transformations.description: GWASL coverage mapping: 270 for CPEquipBrkCov, 010 for CPINCCCov or specific loss causes (fire, lightning, etc.), else 021
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPEquipBrkCov') THEN '270' WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPINCCCov') THEN '010' WHEN tlc.TYPECODE IN ('fire','fire-wood_coal-stove','ightning','vandalism','explosion','sprinkler','sprinkler_leakage') THEN '010' ELSE '021' END

transformations.description: Complex TFGTran derivation based on transaction type, cost type, DoesNotErodeReserves, recovery category, and rownum for reserves
transformations.expression: Multi-branch CASE: Reserve/Indemnity/rownum=1->421, Reserve/Indemnity/rownum>1->431, Reserve/NonIndemnity/rownum=1->422, Reserve/NonIndemnity/rownum>1->432, Payment/Indemnity/DoesNotErode=1->321, Payment/Indemnity/DoesNotErode=0->331, Payment/NonIndemnity/DoesNotErode=1->322, Payment/NonIndemnity/DoesNotErode=0->332, Recovery/Credit_loss/Indemnity->321, Recovery/Credit_loss/NonIndemnity->322, Recovery/credit_exp->322, Recovery/deductible->321, Recovery/salvage/Indemnity->341, Recovery/salvage/NonIndemnity->342, Recovery/subro/Indemnity->351, Recovery/subro/NonIndemnity->353, else 'XXX'

transformations.description: TransAmount calculation: Payment with DoesNotErodeReserves=0 negated, Recovery negated, else positive
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Payment' THEN CASE WHEN t.DoesNotErodeReserves=0 THEN ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)*-1 ELSE tl.TransactionAmount END WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' THEN ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)*-1 ELSE ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0) END

transformations.description: Format Amount as 12-char signed string with special negative handling for Recovery vs non-Recovery
transformations.expression: Complex string formatting using CONCAT, RIGHT, CAST to numeric(11,2) with sign handling

transformations.description: Sum TransAmount grouped by PolSource, remapped LOBCode, PolicyNumber
transformations.expression: SUM(TransAmount) GROUP BY PolSource, LOBCode, PolicyNumber

transformations.description: ExpCode derivation based on cost type, cost category, line category
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN CST.NAME='Indemnity' THEN spaces WHEN ccat.TYPECODE IN ('legalexpense_ext','appraisal_ext') THEN UPPER(ccat.TYPECODE) WHEN lc.TYPECODE IN ('deductible','formerdeductible') THEN UPPER(ccat.TYPECODE) WHEN lc.TYPECODE IS NOT NULL THEN UPPER(lc.TYPECODE) WHEN lc.TYPECODE IS NULL AND ccat.TYPECODE='autoparts' THEN 'OTHER' ELSE UPPER(ccat.TYPECODE) END

business_rules: Line of Business 'Business Owners Line' must be remapped to 'BP7Line' for reporting.
Line of Business starting with 'Workers' must be remapped to 'Workers Comp Line'.
Policies with NULL PolicyPrefix_Ext are classified as 'Legacy', others as 'Guidewire'.
Claim representative (ClaimRep1) depends on ProducerCode prefix '13' (Indiana) using InRepID_ext, else OhRepID_ext.
Subro representative (ClaimRep2) defaults to '00000' if SubroRepresentative_Ext is NULL.
Underwriting company names map to fixed 3-char codes: LRM, WRM, SON, else UNK.
Accounting date (AcctDate) is the later of transaction line CreateTime and transaction set ApprovalDate (default 01/01/2000).

TFGTran codes follow a strict matrix: Reserve transactions sequenced by rownum (421/431 for Indemnity, 422/432 for Non-Indemnity); Payment transactions depend on DoesNotErodeReserves (321/331 Indemnity, 322/332 Non-Indemnity); Recovery transactions depend on recovery category and cost type (321/322/341/342/351/353).
TFGASL and GWASL coverage mapping codes (270, 010, 021) are determined by coverage type and loss cause.
Transaction amounts: Payments that do not erode reserves are positive; payments that erode reserves are negative; recoveries are always negative; reserves are positive.
Amount field is formatted as 12-character signed numeric string with leading zeros and explicit sign for negatives.
Deductible amount (DedStatAmount) only populated for specific EPLI coverages (BP7EmploymentPracticesLiabilityInsurance, BP7SupplementalExtendReportingPeriodEPLI) and capped at 99999.

properties.description: Map underwriting company name to 3-char code: LRM, WRM, SON, else UNK
properties.expression: CASE WHEN uw.name='Lightning Rod Mutual Insurance Company' THEN 'LRM' WHEN uw.name='Western Reserve Mutual Casualty Company' THEN 'WRM' WHEN uw.name='Sonnenberg Mutual Insurance Company' THEN 'SON' ELSE 'UNK' END

properties.description: Format dates as CHAR(8) YYYYMMDD using CONVERT(101) and REPLACE
AcctDate = later of tl.CreateTime and tset.ApprovalDate (default 01/01/2000)
properties.expression: CASE WHEN tl.CreateTime >= ISNULL(tset.ApprovalDate,'01/01/2000') THEN CAST(tl.CreateTime AS date) ELSE CAST(tset.approvaldate AS date) END

properties.description: TFGASL coverage mapping: 270 for CPEquipBrkCov, 010 for CPINCCCov or CicsClaimCov_Ext in (615,616,617,618), else 021
properties.expression: CASE WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPEquipBrkCov') THEN '270' WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPINCCCov') THEN '010' WHEN cv.CicsClaimCov_Ext IN ('615','616','617','618') THEN '010' ELSE '021' END

properties.description: GWASL coverage mapping: 270 for CPEquipBrkCov, 010 for CPINCCCov or specific loss causes (fire, lightning, etc.), else 021
properties.expression: CASE WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPEquipBrkCov') THEN '270' WHEN ct.typecode IN ('CPINCCCov') THEN '010' WHEN tlc.TYPECODE IN ('fire','fire-wood_coal-stove','ightning','vandalism','explosion','sprinkler','sprinkler_leakage') THEN '010' ELSE '021' END

properties.description: Complex TFGTran derivation based on transaction type, cost type, DoesNotErodeReserves, recovery category, and rownum for reserves
properties.expression: Multi-branch CASE: Reserve/Indemnity/rownum=1->421, Reserve/Indemnity/rownum>1->431, Reserve/NonIndemnity/rownum=1->422, Reserve/NonIndemnity/rownum>1->432, Payment/Indemnity/DoesNotErode=1->321, Payment/Indemnity/DoesNotErode=0->331, Payment/NonIndemnity/DoesNotErode=1->322, Payment/NonIndemnity/DoesNotErode=0->332, Recovery/Credit_loss/Indemnity->321, Recovery/Credit_loss/NonIndemnity->322, Recovery/credit_exp->322, Recovery/deductible->321, Recovery/salvage/Indemnity->341, Recovery/salvage/NonIndemnity->342, Recovery/subro/Indemnity->351, Recovery/subro/NonIndemnity->353, else 'XXX'

properties.description: TransAmount calculation: Payment with DoesNotErodeReserves=0 negated, Recovery negated, else positive
properties.expression: CASE WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Payment' THEN CASE WHEN t.DoesNotErodeReserves=0 THEN ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)*-1 ELSE tl.TransactionAmount END WHEN tt.TYPECODE='Recovery' THEN ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0)*-1 ELSE ISNULL(tl.TransactionAmount,0) END

properties.description: Format Amount as 12-char signed string with special negative handling for Recovery vs non-Recovery
properties.expression: Complex string formatting using CONCAT, RIGHT, CAST to numeric(11,2) with sign handling

properties.description: Sum TransAmount grouped by PolSource, remapped LOBCode, PolicyNumber
properties.expression: SUM(TransAmount) GROUP BY PolSource, LOBCode, PolicyNumber

properties.description: ExpCode derivation based on cost type, cost category, line category
properties.expression: CASE WHEN CST.NAME='Indemnity' THEN spaces WHEN ccat.TYPECODE IN ('legalexpense_ext','appraisal_ext') THEN UPPER(ccat.TYPECODE) WHEN lc.TYPECODE IN ('deductible','formerdeductible') THEN UPPER(ccat.TYPECODE) WHEN lc.TYPECODE IS NOT NULL THEN UPPER(lc.TYPECODE) WHEN lc.TYPECODE IS NULL AND ccat.TYPECODE='autoparts' THEN 'OTHER' ELSE UPPER(ccat.TYPECODE) END

Transactions linked to transaction sets via TransactionSetID

Exposures linked to claims via ClaimID
